title: Forged in the Dark Item (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a Forged-in-the-Dark loadout item. Maps to Sled Dog's gear catalog (a character's loadout). Write from the Blades in the Dark SRD vocabulary; original flavor only.

name.description: Display name. Sled Dog derives the folder slug and namespaced key from it.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what this item is/does — shown on the Manage content page.

kit.description: Which loadout list it belongs to (a general item, a playbook item, or crew gear). Defaults to general when unset.

usage.description: How it bears on the fiction / when it grants effect or position.

note.description: Clarifying note carried into the item's notes.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
